summary: E2E regression testing of AdminCareers.js refactor (Careers/*.jsx module split). Logged in as admin@test.com, navigated to /admin/careers. All 9 tabs (jobs/applications/kanban/tests/employees/attendance/leaves/system/reports) render successfully with ZERO fatal React/JS errors and no 'undefined component' console errors. Kanban renders all 30 status columns with per-card Move… quick-transition selects. Application detail modal opens with all 4 HR action buttons (hr-action-assign-test, hr-action-schedule-interview, hr-action-generate-offer, hr-action-convert-employee) plus modal-status-select, download-resume-btn, note-input, current-status-badge. System tab shows all 3 sub-panes (Audit Log with recent activity rows, Roles & Access, Notification Templates). Reports Separations sub-tab lists 100+ separations with Open buttons. Employees tab exposes 171 emp-onboarding-{id} + 171 emp-letters-{id} buttons. Tests tab exposes create-test-btn. Attendance tab exposes attendance-mark-btn. All tabs data-testid selectors resolve correctly through the newly split module named exports. Only 1 non-fatal console error observed (a 403 resource unrelated to the refactor - present across all tabs identically).

issues: Active tab class 'bg-slate-200 text-white' produces near-invisible white text on light slate background - poor contrast. Inactive tabs also use 'text-slate-500 hover:text-slate-200' where hover state has near-invisible text on white page bg. Pre-existing issue kept during refactor - not a refactor regression but should be fixed.

action_items: Optional (not a refactor regression): improve contrast on the tab strip in AdminCareers.js - active tab uses 'bg-slate-200 text-white' (white on light gray) and hover state uses 'hover:text-slate-200' on white page - both poor contrast. Consider 'bg-white text-slate-900 shadow-sm' for active and 'text-slate-600 hover:text-slate-900' for inactive.
critical_code_review_comments: Refactor is clean: container AdminCareers.js reduced to 475 lines - well below 700-line threshold. Split modules use named exports and shared primitives via ./Careers/shared.jsx and ./Careers/constants.js - no duplication observed.
All props required by each tab (jobs, filters, onEdit/onToggle/onDelete, fetchers, adminId) are wired correctly - E2E flow verified no prop-drilling regression.
One tiny opportunity: shared 'formatStatus' / 'CANONICAL_STATUSES' / 'STATUS_COLORS' correctly extracted to constants.js - good DRY refactor.
Leaves tab default status filter='requested' returns 0 matches on the current dataset - not a bug, but consider defaulting to 'all' or adding empty-state hint. (Pre-existing behaviour.)
seed_data_creation: None - used existing seeded data (100 jobs, 319 applications, 153 active employees, 100+ separations, existing tests/leaves).
context_for_next_testing_agent: AdminCareers.js modular refactor verified end-to-end. All 9 tabs, all data-testid selectors intact. Login flow: /login -> input placeholder 'Enter email, mobile or UID' -> Sign In -> 6 tel[maxlength=1] PIN boxes -> auto redirects to /admin. Then goto /admin/careers directly. Application card testid is app-{application_id} (click the card, not a separate view button).
